description: Ministry of Lands - Order to amend the Ex. Gaz. No.1864/54 of 30.05.2014
reasoning: This gazette content focuses exclusively on amendments to regulations under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013. It details legal modifications to compensation payment procedures and amounts for land acquisition, which falls squarely under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or land transactions themselves.
